required_documents.name: SF-424 Application for Federal Assistance package
required_documents.details: Download the SF-424 package tied to this notice on Grants.gov. Note: the notice says the SF-424 in Grants.gov still asks for a DUNS number even though the instructions mention the UEI.

required_documents.name: Project Abstract Summary
required_documents.details: Short, self-contained summary of purpose and outcomes, typed into the Project Abstract Summary box on Grants.gov. No confidential information.

required_documents.name: Project Narrative (includes Work Plan)
required_documents.details: Maximum 20 pages, single spaced, 12-point font, 1-inch margins, pages numbered. Must use these headings in order: Background, Approach, Applicant Evaluation and Performance Measurement Plan, Organizational Capacity of Applicants to Implement the Approach, Work Plan. Name the file "Project Narrative". Pages over the limit are not reviewed.

required_documents.name: Response organizational chart
required_documents.details: Required to show emergency management capacity. Applications without the organizational chart and work plan are rejected without review.

required_documents.name: Table of Contents
required_documents.details: Separate file covering the whole application and the narrative headings. No page limit. Name it "Table of Contents" and upload under Other Attachment Forms (PDF, Word or Excel).

required_documents.name: Budget Narrative
required_documents.details: Itemized: salaries, fringe, consultants, equipment, supplies, travel, other, contractual, total direct and indirect costs. Include high-level budgets for early emergency activation and for crisis response activities, estimated from real costs of past responses (H1N1, Ebola, Zika, COVID-19). Name it "Budget Narrative".

required_documents.name: Indirect Cost Rate agreement
required_documents.details: Only if requesting indirect costs: current negotiated federal indirect cost rate agreement or cost allocation plan approval letter. Name it "Indirect Cost Rate".

required_documents.name: Report on Programmatic, Budgetary, and Commitment Overlap
required_documents.details: Report any overlap with other applications or awards in the same fiscal year. Upload under Other Attachment Forms with this exact title.

required_documents.name: SAM.gov registration with UEI
required_documents.details: Must be active before applying and renewed yearly. Allow 7 to 10 business days or more.

required_documents.name: Grants.gov registration with an Authorized Organization Representative
required_documents.details: Register the organization on Grants.gov and assign an AOR who can submit. Allow up to five days.

deadlines.when: Start at least 10 business days before you plan to submit
Can take up to 2 business days after submission; submit early

eligibility.summary: States, tribes, and large local health jurisdictions only. Local governments must serve a county of 2 million or more or a city of 400,000 or more. In North Carolina, Attachment A lists only Mecklenburg County Health Department and Wake County Health Department.

cost_share.details: No cost sharing or matching required.

review_criteria.criterion: Approach (gaps identified, timelines for activities and spending)
Organizational capacity for emergency response, including an organizational chart

important_notes: This creates a roster of approved-but-unfunded applicants. Money is only released when CDC declares a public health emergency.
Missing the response organizational chart or work plan means automatic rejection.
Funds cannot be used for research, and generally not for furniture or equipment.
Not subject to NC State Clearinghouse review (Executive Order 12372).
